def calc(aim, n, cnt, cs):
    cur_cnt = cnt[0]
    res = 0
    tmp = []
    for i in range(1, n):
        buy = max(len(cs[i]) - aim + 1, 0)
        for j in range(buy):
            res += cs[i][j]
        cur_cnt += buy
        for j in range(buy, len(cs[i])):
            tmp.append(cs[i][j])

    tmp.sort()
    for i in range(aim - cur_cnt):
        res += tmp[i]

    return res
